answers.question: Which trace did you find most interesting, and what did the agent do well or badly in it?
answers.answer: The trace I found the most interesting was in the second claim of the lookup 6 of the agent where it read "Vector(band)". This was interesting because in the claim "Vector" is not a band itself but rather an album, therefore it is interesting on why the agent would chose to read this section. I think it should have pursued a different lookup, especially because an earlier lookup of search "Vector album band released" gave a response that Vector is a studio album by Haken, therefore no further information on this part of the claim was need, aka unecessary lookup on behalf of the agent.
